_about: Hand-written half of the Photoplan design system's tokens. Colours are NOT here: they are read from the token block in index.html (the source of truth). This file adds usage notes for colours that have none in that block, the grounds each text colour is read on (for the contrast check), and the type, spacing, radius, shadow and size values — every one measured from the running app, none invented. design/build-reference.js --system merges the two into tokens.json.

colorUsage.shadow-07: Hard offset shadow tint, 7%: under the location brief (7px offset).
colorUsage.shadow-08: Hard offset shadow tint, 8%: Coming-up cards, trip pills, condition chips (2px offset).
colorUsage.shadow-10: Hard offset shadow tint, 10%: filter buttons (2px), the matted hero frame (7px).
colorUsage.shadow-12: Hard offset shadow tint, 12%: nav buttons, selects and the search field (3px); any button while pressed (1px).
colorUsage.shadow-14: Hard offset shadow tint, 14%: the map's zoom buttons (2px), dropdown lists such as search results (5px).
colorUsage.shadow-16: Hard offset shadow tint, 16%: a button on hover (4px), the location card on the map (5px).
colorUsage.shadow-18: Hard offset shadow tint, 18%: the toast (4px), the Save button on hover.
colorUsage.shadow-20: Hard offset shadow tint, 20%: dialogs and pop-ups (9px offset).
colorUsage.shadow-28: The one soft shadow: an event bar on hover (0 2px 6px).
colorUsage.scrim: The veil behind dialogs and pop-ups.
colorUsage.focus-ring-strong: 2px ring around click-to-edit text while it is being edited.
colorUsage.focus-ring-photo: 2px ring around the hero caption while focused, over a photograph. Same day and night.
colorUsage.drop-tint: Wash over a photo slot while a file is dragged over it.
colorUsage.paper-a92: Translucent paper: the close button on the map's location card.
colorUsage.paper-a86: Translucent paper: the zoom readout laid over the map.
colorUsage.photo-veil-55: Dark veil behind the round skip and pause buttons on a slideshow. Same day and night.
colorUsage.photo-veil-60: Dark veil behind the round remove and focus-point buttons on a photo. Same day and night.
colorUsage.photo-veil-78: The skip and pause buttons on hover. Same day and night.
colorUsage.photo-veil-80: Dark band across the foot of a photo slot (caption year, hints). Same day and night.
colorUsage.photo-veil-80b: Dark badge on a print-sheet preview (“web size only”). Same day and night.
colorUsage.photo-glass-14: Light glass over a photograph: fill of the small buttons shown in focus-point mode. Same day and night.
colorUsage.photo-glass-50: Light glass over a photograph: border of those small buttons. Same day and night.
colorUsage.lb-scrim: The photo viewer's backdrop. Dark in both themes.
colorUsage.lb-glass-12: The photo viewer's round buttons: fill.
colorUsage.lb-glass-22: The photo viewer's round buttons on hover.
colorUsage.lb-glass-40: The photo viewer's round buttons: border.
colorUsage.on-photo: Text and glyphs set on a photograph or in the photo viewer. Same day and night.
colorUsage.on-photo-active: The focus-point button while its mode is on. Same day and night.

groups.name: Titles and names
groups.note: Zilla Slab (Google Fonts, weights 600 and 700). Every title, place name and number that should feel printed.

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: The page title: a month name, Weather, Trips, Gallery. Scales as clamp(40px, 6vw, 58px); clamp(32px, 10vw, 40px) on phones.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The big number in a year-in-review stat tile.

styles.name: title-month
styles.usage: Month names down the home page; the location name at the head of a brief.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: A trip card's name (22px in the trip pop-up).

styles.name: heading-group
styles.usage: Group headings in the gallery and section headings in the year in review, each followed by a hairline.

styles.name: heading-card
styles.usage: Titles of the weather guide cards.

styles.name: name-list
styles.usage: A location's name in the home list and under a photo in the viewer.

styles.name: heading-day
styles.usage: The date on a forecast day card.

styles.name: name-tile
styles.usage: Names on location tiles, Coming-up cards and trip chips (14px on gallery tiles).

groups.name: Prose
groups.note: Spectral (Google Fonts, weight 400 only). Everything written in sentences.

styles.name: prose-intro
styles.sample: A year of places to point a camera — frost on the fells, bluebells and lavender.
styles.usage: The home page's opening paragraph, in ink-3 (16px for the intro under other page titles).

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: The ridge rising from a sea of valley fog at sunrise.
styles.usage: Running text: a location's idea, the values in a brief, in ink-body.

styles.name: prose-item
styles.sample: A long-lens detail from the top
styles.usage: Checklist items and notes.

styles.name: prose-small
styles.usage: Guide-card text, the Sky row's sentences, the where line beside a name.

styles.name: prose-note
styles.sample: Late Dec–Feb for snow on the tops.
styles.usage: The when line under a location in the home list, in ink-3.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Mostly cloudy · maybe a gap at dusk
styles.usage: One-line summaries on forecast day cards.

groups.name: Labels and data
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono (Google Fonts, weights 400, 500, 600). Labels, buttons, chips and every figure. Labels and buttons are set in capitals with wide tracking; data is not.

styles.name: label-section
styles.usage: A section label, in capitals, in muted, followed by a hairline that runs to the edge.

styles.name: label-button
styles.usage: Text on the 40px nav buttons, in capitals (0.1em on the 31px action buttons).

styles.name: label-row
styles.usage: The label column of a row in a card, in capitals, in label (10px and 9.5px in tighter cards).

styles.name: label-link
styles.usage: Quiet text links with a 1px underline, in capitals (0.08em for map links).

styles.name: label-tag
styles.usage: A location's subject tag and small status badges, in capitals.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Times, bearings, percentages, coordinates.

styles.name: data-day
styles.usage: Day numbers in the calendar grid.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Text in pills and chips, counts, dashed add-buttons (11px, no tracking, in kit chips).

styles.name: event-bar
styles.usage: The label on an event bar in the grid.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Footnotes, the map legend, counts under a label.

styles.name: caption-photo
styles.usage: The caption box on a hero photograph: white on black, bottom-left.

groups.name: Wordmark
groups.note: Figtree 700, capitals, tracked 0.24em. Used for the word PHOTOPLAN and nothing else.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the mark on the home page, in brand-ink (20px on phones).

styles.name: wordmark-small
styles.usage: The small lockup above a page title.

spacing.note: The app has no spacing scale in code: these are the values its layouts actually use, named for where they are used.

tokens.name: page-x
tokens.usage: Left and right padding of the page (13px on phones, below 640px).

tokens.name: page-top
tokens.usage: Padding above the page header.

tokens.name: page-bottom
tokens.usage: Padding below the last section.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Space above a major section such as the calendar grid.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Padding of the largest card, the location brief (20px 22px 22px).

tokens.name: card-pad-sm
tokens.usage: Padding of trip cards and the grid's header strip (14px 18px).

tokens.name: panel-pad
tokens.usage: Padding of small panels: forecast day cards (13px 16px) and guide cards.

tokens.name: row-y
tokens.usage: Padding above and below each label-and-value row in a card; rows are parted by a 1px line-soft rule.

tokens.name: row-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's label column and its value.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles in a grid and between stacked blocks in a header column.

tokens.name: gap-lg
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a two-column grid and between a title and its actions.

tokens.name: gap-md
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a footer and between controls in a row.

tokens.name: gap-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between nav buttons and between a label and its field.

tokens.name: gap-icon
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its text inside a button — the commonest gap in the code.

tokens.name: gap-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between a dot and its label.

tokens.name: button-x
tokens.usage: Left and right padding of a 40px nav button (17px on the green primary).

tokens.name: action-x
tokens.usage: Left and right padding of a 31px action button (8px 14px).

tokens.name: chip-x
tokens.usage: Left and right padding of chips and pills (4px 9px).

tokens.name: chip-y
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of chips and pills.

radius.note: Photoplan is square. Corners are only softened where something is tiny or sits on a photograph.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default: cards, buttons, fields, chips, dialogs and tiles all have square corners.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Event bars in the calendar grid and the 16px tick boxes.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: The hover wash on a list row and on click-to-edit text.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: The photograph in a location brief.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Region dots, and the round controls that sit on a photograph (skip, pause, remove, tick, star).

shadow.note: Shadows are hard offsets with no blur, as if the paper were lifted; each uses one of the shadow-NN tints, which turn to black at night. Hover nudges a button up-left by 1px and lengthens the offset; pressing pushes it down-right and shortens it.

tokens.name: offset-pressed
tokens.usage: Any button while pressed, moved 2px down-right.

tokens.name: offset-sm
tokens.usage: Coming-up cards, trip pills, condition chips.

tokens.name: offset-chip
tokens.usage: Filter buttons (All, UK, International) and other 30px buttons.

tokens.name: offset-md
tokens.usage: Nav buttons, selects and the search field at rest.

tokens.name: offset-hover
tokens.usage: A button on hover, moved 1px up-left.

tokens.name: offset-pop
tokens.usage: Dropdown lists such as the search results.

tokens.name: offset-card
tokens.usage: The location brief; the matted hero frame uses the same offset at 10%.

tokens.name: offset-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and pop-ups, over the scrim.

tokens.name: lip-under
tokens.usage: The 1px lip under flat cards: forecast days, gallery tiles, a closed trip card.

tokens.name: ring-field
tokens.usage: A focused input, with its border turned green.

tokens.name: soft-hover
tokens.usage: The one blurred shadow: an event bar on hover.

size.note: Fixed heights and widths the layouts are built on.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page's single column.

tokens.name: breakpoint-phone
tokens.usage: At or below this width the phone layout applies.

tokens.name: control-nav
tokens.usage: Height of nav buttons, the month picker and the search field.

tokens.name: control-field
tokens.usage: Height of selects and the buttons beside them on tool rows.

tokens.name: control-action
tokens.usage: Height of a card's action buttons (Completed, Schedule photo op, Delete).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of filter buttons, small selects and date fields.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: Height of chips and pills.

tokens.name: label-col
tokens.usage: Width of the label column in a brief's rows (90px in trip cards, 52px on phones).

tokens.name: accent-bar
tokens.usage: The coloured bar across the top of a brief or dialog.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: The coloured left edge of an event bar (4px on Coming-up cards).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.
